name: @octopus-reef/ide
description: The Reef editor surface: run a governed agentic session and watch its tamper-evident evidence chain seal and verify, without leaving the editor.
author: Ran Tao <ran@octopusos.ai>

reef.serverUrl.description: URL of the Reef daemon (`reef serve`) when not using the bundled daemon.

reef.useBundledServer.description: Start the bundled local Reef daemon automatically on editor launch.

reef.updateRepository.description: GitHub owner/repository used by Reef: Check for Updates. The command queries GitHub Releases only when run.

walkthroughs.title: Reef: Verify
walkthroughs.description: Open Reef, run the offline demo session, and verify the evidence chain.

steps.title: Verify a governed session
steps.description: Reef starts a bundled local daemon, opens the session panel, and runs a keyless offline demo. Run Reef: Verify to re-check the evidence log.
